architecture: Architecture: the worker on the laptop pulls jobs; the server plans with choose_slot and settles measured energy into an append-only ledger.
deadzone: Dead zone: a rebate is paid only if the whole band lies above zero, and a backfire is declared only if it lies below zero (worked examples A, C, D, computed by compute_settlement).
e3: E3 (simulated grid and forecast): emissions per job relative to running immediately, choose_slot with defer_z = 1, 504 jobs over 7 days.
e4: E4 (simulated 10 % measurement noise, 2000 jobs per point): a wider dead zone removes false rewards faster than deserved ones.
